findings.description: Decisions paragraph does not mention that the jev_cross_impl [[test]] target is now hosted by sc-jev-py (reason recorded only in sc-jev-py/Cargo.toml comment). Documentation gap only.
findings.remediation: Add one sentence: jev_cross_impl is hosted by the publish = false crate sc-jev-py so no crates.io package carries it.

notes: Dependency hoist changes no edge; ADR-SAG-0016 satisfied by =1.5.0; jev_cross_impl in sc-jev-py creates no sc-jev edge (ADR-SAG-0012 holds); [[bin]] removal fine; REQ-SAG-0132 rewording consistent with ADR-0017/0018, no ADR amendment needed. Out of scope for phase review: boundaries/sc-treesitter/treesitter.toml allowed_dependencies lists only sc-agent-types while the crate also depends on mimalloc, serde_json, tree-sitter* (pre-existing).
